question: What mantra component should be uttered after meditating on the beloved woman?
premises: One suddenly meditates on the beloved woman.
After meditation, an utterance is prescribed.
The utterance is the fourth kūṭa.
inference: After meditating on the beloved woman, one should utter the fourth kūṭa.
plain_english: Suddenly, having meditated on the beloved woman, one should utter the fourth section.
